subject: Locking a 30‑min intro + ops readout — availability inside
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Rivera <samantha@harbortech.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & 30-minute demo — availability options

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: you’re looking to evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency document-to-insight features across customer support and legal workflows. Key constraints you mentioned: EU data residency for some records, and a hard latency SLO for sub-200ms tail for 512-token requests.
- Goal for the demo: show a short walkthrough of the platform (hosted API + routing/fallback), a technical deepdive on latency/caching, and discuss a pilot path.

Proposed 30‑minute demo windows (all PST):
1) Thu Nov 12, 10:00–10:30 PST
2) Thu Nov 12, 15:00–15:30 PST
3) Fri Nov 13, 09:00–09:30 PST

Can you pick the best one (or tell me if another day works)? Please include the stakeholders you want on the call — ideally a product owner, an infra/security contact, and whoever would own the pilot.

Success criteria we’ll aim for in the 30m demo:
- Clear validation of latency/throughput expectations for your typical 128–512 token requests
- Outline of the pilot scope and data handling (residency/encryption)
- Ops/integration checklist and next steps (who owns infra changes, timeline)

I’ve attached a short MVP deck and a proposed agenda. If you prefer, here’s a quick calendar poll to lock a slot: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=harbortech-demo-poll

Attachments: HarborTech-MVP-deck.pdf (2 slides: pilot options + integration checklist)

Thanks — happy to coordinate times that work best for your team.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
